newsitem.title: USA: NYC jobless rate flat at 9.7 pct in April - Hevesi.
newsitem.headline: NYC jobless rate flat at 9.7 pct in April - Hevesi.

text.p: New York City gained 3,700 jobs in April, but the jobless rate steadied at 9.7 percent and the gap between the city and the nation stayed the largest since records were kept, the city comptroller said Wednesday.
Alan Hevesi, in prepared remarks, said that while the private sector added 4,800 jobs--with services accounting all but 300 of them--the public sector cut 1,000.
Banks created the most jobs, adding 1,100, the largest rise since January 1996. Other financial sectors also were strong, as securities firms added 500 positions, and real estate 100.
Business services added the most jobs, 1,600, while health services created 1,000, followed by engineering at 900. Social services and retail both added 500 positions.
But manufacturing shed 900 jobs and construction lost 700.
New York City's jobless rate in April was 4.8 percent higher than the nation's--and 0.3 percentage points above the gap seen in March, Hevesi said.
